business_summary: Red phase INC., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of power distribution equipment, power testing equipment, and communication electronics in China and internationally. It operates through Power Division, New Energy Division, and Communications Division segments. The company offers switchgear inspection and monitoring, transformer testing and monitoring, cable and monitoring, GIS inspection and monitoring, transmission line inspection and monitoring, comprehensive testing, grounding device characteristics parameter measurement, measurement device testing and monitoring, optical inspection, and electrical measurement standard device series products; drone inspection devices; and technical services. It also provides power plant instruments and electrical panel cabinet series products; distribution network automation and power supply products; microwave devices, components, and millimeter-wave subsystems. In addition, the company offers power grid and generation system application products; radio frequency; microwave components and related products; electronic components and electromechanical assembly equipment; communication electronic products; and intelligent infrared thermal imaging systems. Further, it engages in new energy development, construction, and management consulting; computer software development; sales and technical consulting; investment and financial management; general contracting of power projects and maintenance of power facilities; power generation, transmission, and distribution; construction engineering; design, development, construction, and consulting of solar photovoltaic power generation projects; and photovoltaic power generation equipment installation activities. The company was formerly known as Xiamen Red Phase Instruments Inc. and changed its name to Red phase INC. in February 2018. Red phase INC. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
